mechanism: 무역 비용의 변화가 판매량·단가·판매시장 접근성 경로를 통해 매출액의 감소로 이어질 수 있다는 조건부 설명 초안이다.
conditions: 논문의 처치·결과 정의와 대상 기업의 변수 정의가 일치할 것
논문의 모집단·시기·제도 및 효과 발생 시차가 적용 대상과 부합할 것

원자료 R03059의 적용 맥락: This paper analyzes U.S. multinational firms and their foreign affiliates using firm-level BEA data for benchmark years 1994, 1999 and 2004 (and related-party trade in 2002), covering >1,000 U.S. parents and ~3,000 manufacturing affiliates across dozens of host countries. Units are parent firms, affiliates, and manufacturing industries (48 SIC industries). The setting combines a theoretical model of embodied vs. disembodied knowledge transfer with empirical regressions using trade-cost measures (freight, tariffs), R&D and O*NET-based knowledge-intensity measures, and controls for host-market size, institutional quality, and selection into FDI.
